method: Case-insensitive searches of local gd/md/json/yaml/yml/txt/godot/tscn/csv files, runtime string review, filename inventory and selected image inspection. Excluded .git, .godot, tmp and .codex. Public verification sent no project files or story text.
limits: Not an exhaustive OCR review of every image or a legal clearance. No build export, engine validation, license activation, canonical rename, production change or publication performed.

findings.name: Lolth
findings.recommendation: Replace the character name and ensure the released character is an original adaptation rather than merely relabeling the D&D deity.

findings.name: Shar
findings.recommendation: Replace the deity name and independently review her identity, narrative and visual portrayal.

findings.name: Kiss of Shar / The Kiss of Shar / O Beijo de Shar
findings.recommendation: Rename the item because its name carries Shar. No claim that the item itself is a published D&D item.

findings.name: Drow / Drows / First Drows / first drow
findings.recommendation: Optional original species name for independence. Do not label the term automatically prohibited: SRD 5.1 includes Elf, Drow and SRD 5.2 includes Drow lineage under CC-BY-4.0. Licensed SRD content does not license unrelated Lolth/Shar lore or official character artwork.

findings.name: Eol
findings.recommendation: Review separately because Eöl is a Tolkien character. The local Eol is a plane-recreating deity; a similar spelling alone does not establish that the local character was copied.

no_D&D_association_found.note: No rename requirement identified by this D&D-focused audit; not a global uniqueness or trademark clearance. Current enemy and Mark names did not yield a confirmed D&D-specific association.

asset_observations.note: The H-02 board is a reference, not admitted runtime comic art. B-09 proposes captions outside the bitmap. Text cleanup must include those future captions and existing runtime labels/messages. Asset filenames also retain names; changing filenames alone does not change character identity.

jam_rule.finding: The public rules prohibit fan games built on another company's characters and trademarks, as well as ripped IP. Crediting a character does not resolve this submission condition.

validation.broad_name_search: Matched Lolth, Shar, Drow/Drows, Eol and Thalestriel; no matches for the additional known D&D deity/location/creature list searched.
validation.license_crosscheck: Drow located in SRD 5.1 and 5.2; Lolth and Shar not found in those two PDFs.
validation.records_validation: 24 local references resolved and all required ADD paths exist.
validation.concurrent_state_observation: The same B-09 production plan advanced from ART-001 at initial read to ART-002 at final read. No plan-state write was performed by this audit.
